Check.TextScaled = true
Check.TextWrapped = true

-- Scripts:

-- Function to handle commands securely:
local function executeCommand(command)
    -- Check for dangerous or server-only commands
    if string.lower(command):find("/console") then
        warn("The /console command cannot be called from the client.")
        return
    end

    -- Attempt to execute the command
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        if game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RemoteEvent") then
            -- Use RemoteEvent to send the command to the server
            game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteEvent:FireServer(command)
        else
            -- Execute locally if allowed
            loadstring(command)()
        end
    end)

    -- Handle errors
    if not success then
        warn("Error executing command: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end

-- Execute Button Logic:
Execute.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local scriptCode = Script.Text
    if scriptCode and scriptCode ~= "" then
        executeCommand(scriptCode)
    else
        warn("No script provided.")
    end
end)

-- Clear Button Logic:
Clear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Script.Text = "" -- Clears the textbox
end)

-- Check Button Logic (Eerie Message):
Check.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local msg = Instance.new("Message", workspace)
    msg.Text = "Welcome to Tubers93 GUI..."
    wait(2)
    msg.Text = "Execute at your own risk!"
    wait(2)
    msg:Destroy()
end)
